findings.summary: WikiSearch.remove_page swallows lancedb row-deletion errors with a bare 'except Exception: pass', discarding the error text. Spec §9 broadly prohibits silent exception swallowing ('所有 except 必须保留原始异常文本进日志或返回体'). This is a best-effort vector-cleanup path (wiki_search already filters stale vectors by page-file existence at store.py:205-207), so it does not reproduce the silent-vector-death failure mode INV-4 targets, but it technically deviates from the spec's blanket prohibition.
